Digital media store |accessableby= iOS, iPadOS, {{wp|tvOS}}, {{wp|macOS}}, {{wp|Microsoft Windows|Windows}} |externallink=[https://www.apple.com/itunes/ apple.com/itunes] }} The '''iTunes Store''' is a digital distribution service owned and operated by {{wp|Apple Inc.|Apple}}, and is the official app store for the {{wp|iOS}} and {{wp|iPadOS}} operating systems. The service sells apps, books, music, movies, and TV shows, although these are all accessed in different ways depending on the user's operating system. ==Games & apps== The {{wp|App Store (iOS)|App Store}} launched on July 10, 2008,[https://appleinsider.com/articles/08/07/10/apples_app_store_launches_with_more_than_500_apps ''Apple's App Store launches with more than 500 apps'' - AppleInsider] (retrieved May 10, 2020) in time for the release of the {{wp|iPhone 3G}} the next day.[https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2008/07/10iPhone-3G-on-Sale-Tomorrow/ ''iPhone 3G on Sale Tomorrow'' - Apple Inc.] (retrieved May 10, 2020) It is the official app store for the iOS and iPadOS operating systems and as of May 2020, it had 1,847,000 apps available for download.[https://www.statista.com/statistics/276623/number-of-apps-available-in-leading-app-stores/ ''Number of apps available in leading app stores as of 1st quarter 2020'' - Statista] (retrieved May 10, 2020) The App Store is accessed through a dedicated app on the {{wp|iPhone}}, {{wp|iPod Touch}} or {{wp|iPad}} or via previews on Apple's website. As of April 2020, the App Store is available in 175 countries and regions around the world.[https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2020/04/apple-services-now-available-in-more-countries-around-the-world/ ''Apple Services now available in more countries around the world'' - Apple Inc.] (retrieved May 10, 2020) ===Available Pokémon games & apps=== {{main|:Category:Mobile games|List of mobile games}} ==Movies & TV== Movies first appeared for rental, and later purchase, on the iTunes Store in 2008.[https://appleinsider.com/articles/08/05/01/apple_expected_to_announce_new_movie_sales_in_itunes.html ''Apple announces same day as DVD release iTunes movie sales'' - AppleInsider] (retrieved May 10, 2020) It is possible to purchase and rent movies and TV shows through the iTunes Store in many countries around the world.[https://support.apple.com/en-gb/HT204411 ''Availability of Apple Media Services'' - Apple Inc.] (retrieved May 10, 2020) Movies and TV shows are accessible through the iTunes Store app on iOS and iPad OS; the {{wp|iTunes|iTunes client}} on {{wp|Microsoft Windows}} and {{wp|macOS Mojave|Mojave}} or older {{wp|macOS}} systems; the {{wp|Apple TV (software)|Apple TV apps}} on {{wp|macOS Catalina}}, {{wp|tvOS}} devices and certain smart TVs; or as a preview on the Apple website. ===Available Pokémon anime=== {{main|List of digital home video releases of Pokémon animation}} ===Available Pokémon movies=== {{main|List of digital home video releases of Pokémon animation#Movies|List of digital home video releases of Pokémon animation → Movies}} ==Music== The iTunes Music Store was launched by {{wp|Steve Jobs}} at the {{wp|Apple Worldwide Developers Conference}} 2003, and by February 2010, had become the largest music vendor in the world.[https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2010/02/25iTunes-Store-Tops-10-Billion-Songs-Sold/ ''iTunes Store Tops 10 Billion Songs Sold'' - Apple Inc.] (retrieved May 10, 2020) In response to the decline in music sales and the rise of streaming services like [[Spotify]], the {{wp|Apple Music}} subscription service was launched on June 30, 2015,[https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2015/06/08Introducing-Apple-Music-All-The-Ways-You-Love-Music-All-in-One-Place-/ ''Introducing Apple Music — All The Ways You Love Music. All in One Place.'' - Apple Inc.] (retrieved May 10, 2020) which as of April 2020, is available in 167 countries and regions. On iOS and iPadOS devices, music is available for purchase on the iTunes Store app, and Apple Music is available through the {{wp|Music (software)|Music app}}. On Windows and Mojave or older macOS systems the iTunes store and Apple Music are available through the iTunes client.
